r: sf::st_as_sf(data, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 3857, remove = FALSE)
task: Declare planar point geometry and coordinate reference system
task_zh: 声明平面点几何及坐标参考系统
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Creating an sf object does not set Stata dataset metadata. Coordinates and CRS must describe the actual data; do not assign a projected CRS to longitude/latitude.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。sf对象不设置Stata数据元信息；坐标与CRS必须符合真实数据，不能给经纬度直接指定投影坐标系。
meaning: spset: Declare planar point geometry and coordinate reference system

r: { D <- as.matrix(stats::dist(data[c("x", "y")])); W <- matrix(0, nrow(D), ncol(D)); off <- row(D) != col(D); W[off] <- 1 / D[off]; W / rowSums(W) }
task_zh: 行标准化逆距离空间权重
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Planar distances, distinct non-coincident locations and matching row/column ID order are required. Stata defaults to spectral normalization, so row normalization is explicit.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。要求平面距离、位置互异且矩阵行列ID顺序一致；Stata默认谱标准化，本例明确使用行标准化。

detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. W must use the identical unit ordering as data; this operation does not fit a spatial autoregressive model.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。W必须与数据采用完全一致的空间单元顺序；该运算不拟合空间自回归模型。
meaning: spgenerate: Compute a spatially lagged covariate

task: Distance between two identified planar locations
task_zh: 两个指定平面位置之间的距离
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Planar Euclidean distance only; longitude/latitude require a geodesic calculation and explicit units.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。仅计算平面欧氏距离；经纬度应使用大地距离并明确单位。
meaning: spdistance: Distance between two identified planar locations

r: { counts <- table(data$time); common <- as.numeric(names(counts)[counts == length(unique(data$id))]); data[data$time %in% common, , drop = FALSE] }
task: Balance a spatial panel by retaining common time periods
task_zh: 保留共同时间期以平衡空间面板
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Requires unique unit/time pairs. Mirrors spbalance's choice to drop incomplete time periods while retaining spatial units; it does not fill missing outcomes.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。要求空间单元和时间组合唯一；对应spbalance保留空间单元而剔除不完整时间期的方式，不填补缺失结局。
setup: data <- expand.grid(time = 1:4, id = 1:3); data <- data[!(data$id == 2 & data$time == 2), ]; data$value <- seq_len(nrow(data))
meaning: spbalance: Balance a spatial panel by retaining common time periods

r: transform(data, ever_x = ave(x == 1, id, FUN = function(v) as.integer(any(v))))
task: Mark subjects ever exposed during their observed survival history
task_zh: 标记生存观察史中曾经暴露的受试者
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. All observed spells contribute to the history. Missing exposure values require an explicit convention rather than treating NA as false.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。所有已观察区间均参与历史计算；暴露缺失值须明确处理，不能默认当作未暴露。
setup: data <- data.frame(id = rep(1:2, each = 3), start = rep(c(0, 2, 4), 2), stop = rep(c(2, 4, 6), 2), event = c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0), x = c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), z = c(5, NA, 7, 8, NA, NA))
meaning: stgen: Mark subjects ever exposed during their observed survival history

r: { out <- data[order(data$id, data$start), ]; out$z <- ave(out$z, out$id, FUN = function(v) zoo::na.locf(v, na.rm = FALSE)); out }
task: Carry observed covariates forward within survival subjects
task_zh: 在生存分析受试者内向前携带已观察协变量
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Requires correctly ordered non-overlapping spells. Leading missing values remain missing; later information is never carried backward.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。要求区间顺序正确且不重叠；开头缺失仍保留，后续信息不会向前期回填。
setup: data <- data.frame(id = rep(1:2, each = 3), start = rep(c(0, 2, 4), 2), stop = rep(c(2, 4, 6), 2), event = c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0), x = c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), z = c(5, NA, 7, 8, NA, NA))
meaning: stfill: Carry observed covariates forward within survival subjects

r: lapply(split(data, data$id), function(d) vapply(d[c("x", "z")], function(v) c(varies = length(unique(v[!is.na(v)])) > 1, any_missing = anyNA(v)), logical(2)))
task: Check within-subject covariate variation and missingness
task_zh: 检查受试者内协变量变化及缺失
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Returns per-subject flags rather than Stata's aggregate summary table; ignores sampling weights as stvary does.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。返回逐受试者标记而非Stata汇总表；与stvary一样忽略抽样权重。
setup: data <- data.frame(id = rep(1:2, each = 3), start = rep(c(0, 2, 4), 2), stop = rep(c(2, 4, 6), 2), event = c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0), x = c(0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), z = c(5, NA, 7, 8, NA, NA))
meaning: stvary: Check within-subject covariate variation and missingness

r: { out <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; previous <- ave(out$time, out$id, FUN = function(v) c(NA_real_, head(v, -1))); previous_x <- ave(out$x, out$id, FUN = function(v) c(NA_real_, head(v, -1))); out$start <- previous; out$x <- previous_x; out[!is.na(out$start), ] }
task: Convert snapshots to intervals with covariates applying forward
task_zh: 将快照转为协变量向后续区间生效的区间数据
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. The first snapshot defines interval entry, event indicators apply at interval exit, and ordinary covariates apply forward. This explicit workflow drops initial zero-duration rows; check Stata's retained baseline rows before matching row counts.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。首个快照定义进入时间，事件在区间末发生，普通协变量向后续区间生效；本流程剔除初始零长度行，比较行数时须核对Stata保留的基线行。
check: stopifnot(nrow(.result) == 4, identical(.result$start, c(0, 2, 0, 3)), identical(.result$x, c(4, 5, 7, 8)), sum(.result$event) == 1)
meaning: snapspan: Convert snapshots to intervals with covariates applying forward

r: { ends <- c(2, 4, 6); starts <- c(0, 2, 4); n <- vapply(starts, function(t) sum(data$time >= t), integer(1)); d <- vapply(seq_along(ends), function(i) sum(data$time >= starts[i] & data$time < ends[i] & data$event == 1), integer(1)); w <- vapply(seq_along(ends), function(i) sum(data$time >= starts[i] & data$time < ends[i] & data$event == 0), integer(1)); q <- d / (n - w / 2); data.frame(start = starts, end = ends, at_risk = n, failures = d, withdrawals = w, survival = cumprod(1 - q)) }
task: Actuarial life-table survival over fixed intervals
task_zh: 固定区间的精算寿命表生存率
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Uses the half-withdrawal actuarial adjustment and left-closed intervals; censoring is assumed uniform within each interval. Boundary conventions and intervals must match.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。使用退出人数减半的精算修正及左闭区间，假设区间内删失均匀；须统一边界规则和分组区间。
meaning: ltable: Actuarial life-table survival over fixed intervals

r: with(data, sum(events1 * time0 / (time1 + time0)) / sum(events0 * time1 / (time1 + time0)))
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Input is pre-aggregated failure counts and person-time by exposure/stratum. This supplies the rate-ratio point estimate only, not Stata's variance or trend tests.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。输入为按暴露和分层汇总的事件数及人时；仅计算发生率比点估计，不含Stata的方差和趋势检验。
setup: data <- data.frame(stratum = 1:2, events1 = c(10, 20), events0 = c(5, 10), time1 = c(100, 200), time0 = c(100, 200))
meaning: stmh: Mantel-Haenszel stratified incidence-rate-ratio point estimate

r: { cases <- which(data$event == 1); sets <- lapply(seq_along(cases), function(j) { i <- cases[j]; at_risk <- which(data$entry <= data$time[i] & data$time >= data$time[i] & data$id != data$id[i]); controls <- sample(at_risk, min(2L, length(at_risk)), replace = FALSE); out <- data[c(i, controls), ]; out$case <- c(1L, rep(0L, length(controls))); out$set <- j; out$failure_time <- data$time[i]; out }); do.call(rbind, sets) }
task: Sample nested case-control risk sets from a cohort
task_zh: 从队列风险集抽取巢式病例对照样本
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. One-record cohort with no tied failures. Controls are sampled from those at risk for each failure and may recur across sets; tied-failure random ordering and multiple spells need a fuller implementation.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。示例为无并列失败的单记录队列；每次从风险集抽对照，同一人可出现在多个匹配集。并列失败排序和多区间数据需更完整实现。
setup: set.seed(142); data <- data.frame(id = 1:8, entry = rep(0, 8), time = 1:8, event = c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0))
meaning: sttocc: Sample nested case-control risk sets from a cohort

r: MatchIt::matchit(treat ~ category, data = transform(data, category = as.integer(category) - 1L), method = "cem", estimand = "ATT", cutpoints = list(category = 0))
task: Coarsened exact matching on a categorical covariate
task_zh: 分类协变量的粗化精确匹配
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Matching preprocessing only; categorical levels need no continuous cutpoints. For continuous variables, explicitly match cutpoints and estimand rather than relying on different software defaults.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。仅进行匹配预处理；分类水平不需要连续切点。连续变量须明确统一切点和目标估计量，不能依赖不同软件默认值。
setup: set.seed(143); data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(200), z = rnorm(200)); data$treat <- as.integer(seq_len(200) %% 4 == 0); data$category <- factor(data$x > 0); data$y <- 2 * data$treat + data$x + rnorm(200)
meaning: cem: Coarsened exact matching on a categorical covariate

task: Standardized covariate balance before and after matching
task_zh: 匹配前后标准化协变量平衡
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Companion command supplied with psmatch2. Choose the same standardization denominator; cobalt's balance table does not reproduce every pstest t-test or omnibus summary.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。psmatch2配套命令；须选择相同标准化分母。cobalt平衡表不复现pstest所有t检验和总体汇总量。
setup: set.seed(143); data <- data.frame(x = rnorm(200), z = rnorm(200)); data$treat <- as.integer(seq_len(200) %% 4 == 0); data$category <- factor(data$x > 0); data$y <- 2 * data$treat + data$x + rnorm(200); match <- MatchIt::matchit(treat ~ x + z, data = data, method = "nearest", replace = TRUE, estimand = "ATT")
meaning: pstest: Standardized covariate balance before and after matching

r: transform(data, cohort = ave(ifelse(treated == 1, time, Inf), id, FUN = function(v) { first <- min(v); rep(if(is.infinite(first)) 0 else first, length(v)) }))
task: Create first-treatment cohorts including never-treated units
task_zh: 构造首次处理队列并标记从未处理者
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Uses zero as a never-treated category for cohort-based DiD. An absorbing treatment history and unique unit/time records are prerequisites; imputation estimators may instead require missing never-treatment times.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。以零表示从未处理队列；要求处理一旦开始便持续且个体时间组合唯一。插补估计量可能要求用缺失表示从未处理时间。
setup: data <- expand.grid(time = 1:5, id = 1:3); data$treated <- as.integer((data$id == 1 & data$time >= 3) | (data$id == 2 & data$time >= 4))
meaning: gencohort: Create first-treatment cohorts including never-treated units

r: fixest::feols(y ~ treated + x | id + time, data = data, vcov = ~id, nthreads = 1)
task: Panel difference-in-differences with unit and period fixed effects
task_zh: 个体和时期固定效应面板双重差分
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Homogeneous-effect two-group design with parallel trends and no anticipation. Under staggered timing and heterogeneous effects, TWFE is not a replacement for modern cohort-specific estimators; covariance finite-sample conventions can differ.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。示例为平行趋势和无预期下的两组同质效应设计。处理错时且效应异质时，TWFE不能替代现代队列特异估计；协方差有限样本约定可能不同。
setup: set.seed(144); data <- expand.grid(time = 1:6, id = 1:40); data$treated <- as.integer(data$id <= 20 & data$time >= 4); data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$y <- data$id / 10 + .3 * data$time + 2 * data$treated + .4 * data$x + rnorm(nrow(data), sd = .2)
meaning: xtdidregress: Panel difference-in-differences with unit and period fixed effects

stata: xtdpd y L.y x, div(x) dgmmiv(y, lagrange(2 3))
r: { plm <- plm::plm; plm::pgmm(y ~ lag(y, 1) + x | lag(y, 2:3), data = pd, effect = "individual", model = "onestep", transformation = "d", collapse = TRUE) }
task: One-step difference GMM for a dynamic panel
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Supports the standard difference-GMM subset, with deliberately collapsed instruments. Stata xtdpd supports richer error processes; align instruments, initial weight matrices and finite-sample corrections before comparing.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。仅支持标准差分GMM子集，并明确压缩工具变量。xtdpd还支持更复杂误差过程；比较前须统一工具变量、初始权重矩阵及有限样本修正。
setup: set.seed(145); N <- 80; T <- 10; data <- expand.grid(time = 1:T, id = 1:N); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); u <- rnorm(N); data$y <- 0; for(i in 1:N) { ix <- which(data$id == i); previous <- u[i] / .6 + rnorm(1); for(j in ix) { data$y[j] <- .4 * previous + .7 * data$x[j] + u[i] + rnorm(1); previous <- data$y[j] } }; pd <- plm::pdata.frame(data, index = c("id", "time"))
meaning: xtdpd: One-step difference GMM for a dynamic panel

r: { plm <- plm::plm; plm::pgmm(y ~ lag(y, 1) + x | lag(y, 2:3), data = pd, effect = "individual", model = "onestep", transformation = "ld", collapse = TRUE) }
task: System GMM with level and differenced equations
task_zh: 水平方程与差分方程的系统GMM
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. Additional level moment conditions require stronger initial-condition assumptions. Instrument collapsing, instrument ranges and weighting differ unless explicitly matched; no blanket parity with xtdpdsys defaults.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。额外水平方程矩条件要求更强的初始条件假设；须明确统一工具变量压缩、范围及权重，不能声称与xtdpdsys默认设置完全相同。
setup: set.seed(145); N <- 80; T <- 10; data <- expand.grid(time = 1:T, id = 1:N); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; data$x <- rnorm(nrow(data)); u <- rnorm(N); data$y <- 0; for(i in 1:N) { ix <- which(data$id == i); previous <- u[i] / .6 + rnorm(1); for(j in ix) { data$y[j] <- .4 * previous + .7 * data$x[j] + u[i] + rnorm(1); previous <- data$y[j] } }; pd <- plm::pdata.frame(data, index = c("id", "time"))
meaning: xtdpdsys: System GMM with level and differenced equations

stata: xthtaylor y x1 x2 a b, endog(x2 b) constant(a b)
r: plm::plm(y ~ x1 + x2 + a + b | x1 + a | x2, data = data, index = c("id", "time"), random.method = "ht", model = "random", inst.method = "baltagi")
task: Hausman-Taylor model with time-varying and invariant endogenous covariates
task_zh: 含时变与时不变内生协变量的Hausman-Taylor模型
detail: Fixed workflow; adapt the named data columns explicitly. The three-part R formula explicitly separates exogenous covariates and time-varying endogenous covariates. Identification of invariant endogenous effects requires sufficient exogenous time-varying instruments; these classifications need substantive justification.
detail_zh: 固定流程；请明确调整示例列名。R三部分公式明确区分外生协变量及时变内生协变量；时不变内生效应识别要求足够的外生时变工具变量，这些分类须有实质依据。
setup: set.seed(146); data <- expand.grid(time = 1:8, id = 1:60); data <- data[order(data$id, data$time), ]; u <- rnorm(60); data$a <- rep(rnorm(60), each = 8); data$b <- rep(u + rnorm(60, sd = .5), each = 8); data$x1 <- rnorm(nrow(data)); data$x2 <- rep(u, each = 8) + rnorm(nrow(data)); data$y <- 1 + data$x1 + .5 * data$x2 + .4 * data$a + .3 * data$b + rep(u, each = 8) + rnorm(nrow(data))
meaning: xthtaylor: Hausman-Taylor model with time-varying and invariant endogenous covariates
